mentions.name: runz
mentions.description: This is a game in early development that is undergoing playtests while one or two core elements of the fun/gameplay loop are still being built out. It has a live itch.io page and a validated Steam store page, and it is the team's second game project, made with the author's brother.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Started some playtests for our game with my brother (I mean we don't REALLY have testers yet, we need a bit more work first because right now it's lacking 1 or 2 core elements of the fun / gameplay loop):
https://srdnvntrz.itch.io/runz

also created and got our steam page validated:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4704420/runz/
